symptom: ako/mxcli#854 (follow-up of #842): an action on a data grid filter (`OnChange:` on textfilter / numberfilter / datefilter / dropdownfilter), a barcode scanner (`onDetect:`) or a combo box's onEnterEvent / onLeaveEvent / onChangeFilterInputEvent was refused under `mdl 1;` (4x MDL-WIDGET37, 4x MDL-WIDGET06 on one page) and dropped with MDL-V1-ACTIONSLOT / MDL-WIDGET06 warnings under mdl 0; describe printed no filter action, so a Studio Pro-authored one could not be restated, retargeted or removed.
cause: These widgets' definitions are hand-written and embedded (sdk/widgets/definitions), and a hand-written def beats the generator that maps every action slot of a generated widget. Theirs mapped none of these slots, so resolveMapping never read the action; describe's filter branch read no action and the known-type output branch printed no named slots. The combo box's onChangeDatabaseEvent named in the issue was already fixed by mendixlabs/mxcli#1583 (database mode, sourced from OnChange).
file: sdk/widgets/definitions/{text,number,date,dropdown}filter.def.json (onChange <- OnChange, in every mode of the dropdown filter), barcodescanner.def.json (onDetect named), combobox.def.json (onEnterEvent / onLeaveEvent / onChangeFilterInputEvent named, in all three modes) + modelsdk mirrors; mdl/executor/cmd_pages_describe_parse.go (filter OnChange, combo box NamedActions); cmd_pages_describe_output.go (known-type branch prints named slots, which no longer route a combo box into the generic branch); widget_named_action_slot.go (embeddedSourcedActionKeys: a slot a def sources from OnClick/OnChange under a key actionSourceForKey does not know — onChangeDatabaseEvent — is not also printed by key)
insight: Test the hypothesis before fixing the half that may already be fixed: the 'filter onChange lost on rebuild' bullet already held on main through #832's per-property patch (statement and shadow build both wrote NoAction, so the stored action was kept) — proven by seeding a Studio Pro-shaped Forms$MicroflowAction into the filter's onChange, editing the filter via describe->exec, and stubbing patchStoredPluggable as the control (fails 'reset its onChange to Forms$NoAction'); a sibling edit needed patch AND passthrough stubbed to fail. What the mapping adds is that describe can SAY the action, so a statement can keep, retarget or remove it. The cheap audit for this class is mechanical: TestBuiltinDefsMapEveryActionSlot diffs each embedded def's action mappings against the action properties its .mpk declares (testdata), and requires a named slot in EVERY mode — selectMappings ignores top-level mappings of a def with modes. Spell new slots the way the generator would (actionSourceForKey): `onChange` -> `OnChange:`, anything else by its own key. A def-sourced slot under an unusual key (onChangeDatabaseEvent) must be excluded from describe's by-key list or it is printed twice. Real mx check (11.13.0, --no-update-widgets): all eight actions written, 0 errors, describe->exec 'Unchanged page'; fault variant: refused under mdl 1, 0 errors under mdl 0 with every action missing.
